svg.title: The Big Ten's playoff premium is a travel allowance, not prize money
svg.text: The Big Ten's playoff premium is a travel allowance, not prize money
Premium over the median of the thirteen Big Ten full-share schools that played no playoff game, $78,057,558.
Above: per game, against the $3,000,000 travel allowance. Below: totals, against what prize money alone would add.
prize money for the bid, if passed through
no prize figure stated for a three-game run
prize money for the title run, before travel, if passed through
filed premium over the non-playoff median, Form 990, calculated
one $3,000,000 travel allowance per game, announced College Football Playoff figure
prize money alone, announced CFP figure, if passed through
Source: Big Ten Form 990, fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, Schedule A, Part I, via ProPublica. Travel allowance and prize amounts are announced College Football Playoff figures.
Median, premiums, and per-game figures calculated; per-game figures rounded to the dollar.
